title: MALM bed frame
description: MALM bed frame, oak veneer/Luröy, Full A clean design that’s just as beautiful on all sides – place the bed on its own or with the headboard against a wall. If you need space for extra bedding, add MALM bed storage boxes on casters.
features: SKORVA midbeam is included in the price but packaged separately. It is required for the stability of the bed frame and to keep the mattress in place.
LURÖY slatted bed base is included in the price, but is packaged separately.
Add 2 or 4 MALM bed boxes to create lots of extra storage space.
Mattress and bedlinens are sold separately.
materialAndCare: Head/footboard: Particleboard, Fiberboard, Honeycomb structure paper filling (min. 70% recycled), Oak veneer, Stain, Clear acrylic lacquer, Printed and embossed acrylic paint, Plastic edging; Bedside: Particleboard, Fiberboard, Oak veneer, Stain, Clear acrylic lacquer, Printed and embossed acrylic paint, Paper, Plastic edging; Galvanized steel; Bed slats: Layer-glued wood veneer, Adhesive resin as coating; Ribbon: 100 %polyester
